observations.content: Assistant reported system clean: only remaining known issue is upstream Paseo zombie spinner bug (#3845/#3847), fix PRs #3848/#3849 not yet merged; workaround is to STOP when answer complete and spinner keeps spinning.

Assistant listed optional user tasks: widen proxy wildcard to *MiniMax-M3*, draft upstream reports for 2-3 unreported pi/Paseo bugs (quiz multiSelect hardcode, title heuristic, pi missing steerActiveTurn), and noted JOURNEY.md OM sits at ~1.9k/1k tokens awaiting auto-trim by consolidator.

Assistant confirmed no session restart needed: all changes after the 13:09 restart are worker-side (loading from disk each run); dev/live extension sync done, 52/52 subagent-types and 108/108 OM tests green, test report updated to 152 lines.
User posted a payload config with wildcard rule for model name *MiniMax-M3* with reasoningsplit true, asked if it's correct, said they saved it, and asked to test it.
User questioned why JOURNEY.md OM at 1.9k/1k tokens auto-trimming was listed in a pending report as a task for them if it happens automatically.

Assistant ran a proxy test with wildcard config for both bare MiniMax-M3 and mmcp/MiniMax-M3 names: both returned no ' thinking' in content and reasoning_content present, confirming wildcard fix works and bare name no longer leaks.

JOURNEY.md was 8,420 bytes (~1.9k tokens), last modified 14:18:46 by the consolidator run that promoted 98 observations; assistant explained it is an APPEND-MOSTLY design with a soft ~1k token target, actively maintained, not an error.
Assistant acknowledged a report presentation mistake: listing the auto-trimming JOURNEY item in the pending-task table was an error in report structure, not a real task for the user.
User asked for a configuration review of every extension/tool/skill now that the workspace is set up and working, requesting all configurable points for each so they can review and adjust.
